in_marathi.long_meaning: Rakesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rakesha means 'Ruler' or 'King'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja', which means 'King'. Rakesha is a powerful name that symbolizes strength, courage, and leadership.
